entities.summary: Fumitake Fujita  is a Japanese businessman and politician. A member of Nippon Ishin no Kai, he has served as a member of the House of Representatives since 2019 and co-leader of Ishin since August 2025, serving alongside Osaka Governor Hirofumi Yoshimura. He previously served as the party’s Secretary-General from 2021 to 2024.
